stdout: --cluster:cluster name or id the question is about
--namespace:namespace the question is about (one namespace; explain takes no --project or -A)
--group:API group when the resource name exists in several groups
--non-resource-url:ask about a non-resource path such as /healthz instead of a resource
--as:subject to explain instead of you: a Rancher user (user id, username, or user principal), a group principal, or a service account
--type:how to read a bare --as value: user or group
--timeout:time limit for the whole command, e.g. 2m (default 60s)
--debug:print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
--no-input:never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
--read-only:refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
--cluster:cluster name or id the question is about
